crash.cause: The page threw while rendering. This is our bug, not something you did. The menu still works — you can go elsewhere meanwhile.
crash.title: This page crashed

error.accountHasNoProject: This account has no projects yet. Add a project and configure its credentials before syncing.
error.actionFailed: The action did not succeed. The server’s reason is shown below.
error.allProjectsSyncing: Every project under this account is already syncing. Wait for them to finish and try again.
error.badRequest: The request was malformed and could not be processed.
error.baselineNeedsPods: This cluster has never had a successful Pod collection, so a baseline taken now can't be compared against later. Run a collection first.
error.cannotDeleteLocalAdmin: The local admin is the last way in and cannot be deleted - without it an SSO outage would lock everyone out.
error.cannotVerifyEnvUsage: Could not determine whether any assets still use this environment, so nothing was deleted — removing it while assets still reference it would invalidate their environment tag. Try again shortly.
error.cannotVerifyProjectUsage: Could not determine whether any assets still belong to this project, so nothing was deleted — removing it while assets still reference it would leave them unattributed. Try again shortly.
error.capacityExceeded: You have reached your licensed capacity limit.
error.cdnEventsNeedFirewallRead: If this reports insufficient permissions, the token needs the Zone · Firewall Services · Read permission.
error.cdnTrafficNeedAnalyticsRead: If this reports insufficient permissions, the token needs Zone · Zone Analytics · Read. If it reports an unknown field, that dataset is most likely unavailable on the current plan.
error.cdnZoneRequired: A zone (root domain, e.g. example.com) is required. The CDN Sites page lists them.
error.certNotIssued: This certificate has not been issued yet, so there is nothing to download.
error.changeAlreadyRolledBack: This change has already been rolled back and cannot be rolled back again.
error.clusterOrGkeInfoMissing: Either the cluster does not exist, or its GKE upgrade information has never been collected — the two cannot be told apart here. Sync it from the data sources page first.
error.conflict: Someone else changed this data in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
error.createSessionFailed: Could not create a sign-in session. Try again.
error.credEncryptFailed: Could not encrypt the credential. This usually means the encryption key is missing or corrupted — contact an administrator.
error.credentialInvalidOrExpired: The sign-in credential is invalid or has expired. Sign in again.
error.decryptSaKeyFailed: Could not decrypt the SA key; the master key may have changed. Contact an administrator.
error.dnsAllRowsInvalid: Every row failed validation, so nothing was written. Per-row reasons are listed below.
error.dnsBatchLimit: At most {{max}} rows can be processed at once — split it into batches.
error.dnsNoDeletable: Nothing can be deleted — the selected records may all be protected (NS / SOA / _acme-challenge). Per-row reasons are listed below.
error.dnsNoEditable: Nothing can be edited. Per-row reasons are listed below.
error.dnsReadRecordsFailed: Could not read the existing DNS records.
error.dnsRecordChangedUpstream: This record has changed at the registrar. Sync once before editing, or you will overwrite someone else’s change.
error.dnsRecordDuplicate: A record with the same value already exists for this host name and type.
error.dnsRecordProtected: This record is protected (NS / SOA / _acme-challenge) and cannot be deleted. Removing it would break the domain’s resolution or its certificate renewal.
error.domainNoSource: This domain has no data source yet. Pick a source or registrar under Edit before syncing.
error.duplicateName: A {{what}} named "{{name}}" already exists. Choose a different name.
error.encryptFailed: Encryption failed. This usually means the encryption key is missing or corrupted — contact an administrator.
error.envInUse: {{count}} assets still use environment "{{code}}" (for example in {{where}}). Deleting it leaves them holding a value that no longer exists in any dropdown — they stay in the list but can never be filtered by environment again. Move them to another environment first.
error.featureNotLicensed: Your current license does not include this feature.
error.fetchUsageFailed: Could not fetch actual usage — Prometheus may be unavailable.
error.forbidden: This account is not allowed to perform that action.
error.forbiddenNeed: You don't have permission for this action (requires {{need}}).
error.harborAuthFailed: Authentication failed (HTTP {{status}}): wrong username or password. Note that robot account usernames must carry the robot$ prefix.
error.harborListProjectsFailed: Could not fetch the project list (HTTP {{status}}).
error.harborParseProjectsFailed: Could not parse the project list.
error.harborParseReposFailed: Could not parse the repository list.
error.healthIncomplete: Health check did not finish ({{item}}). No conclusions were produced — do not read this as "the cluster is fine".
error.idpMissingBasics: The issuer and client ID are required before enabling sign-on. Without them sign-in fails at the redirect step, and the error comes from the identity provider with nothing pointing back here. Your configuration is saved — fill both in, then enable it.
error.idpPrivateHost: Refusing to connect to {{host}}: it resolves to a private address. This request is made by the server, so allowing private targets would turn it into an internal-network probe.
error.idpUnreachable: Cannot reach this identity source. Check the issuer, outbound connectivity, and whether the provider requires an allowlist. This does not mean the configuration is wrong — check the network first.
error.inUse: This record is still referenced by something else and cannot be deleted. Remove the references first.
error.internal: A server error occurred. Send the request ID to your operator — it is the only way to trace this failure.
error.labelsProbeFailed: Couldn't read the label list from this data source: {{reason}}. Run “Test connection” first to confirm the address and token.
error.labelsUnparseable: The label list returned by this data source couldn't be parsed.
error.lastAdmin: This is the last administrator; they cannot be demoted, disabled or deleted. Doing so would leave nobody able to manage permissions, create users or activate licenses — recoverable only from the database. Grant someone else the administrator role first.
error.licenseInvalid: That license string failed signature verification. Usually a segment was lost when pasting, a line break truncated it, or it was signed for a different environment. This is not an expiry — your existing license is untouched.
error.licenseWrongProduct: That license is valid, but it does not cover this product ({{want}}). It covers: {{got}}. Activation was rejected and your existing license is untouched.
error.lokiQueryFailedHint: If this timed out: a label matcher that is too broad (for example a wildcard namespace) makes the log source scan every stream. Narrow the labels or shorten the time window and try again. ⚠️ This is a failed query, not “no logs”.
error.malformed: The request finished but returned no data. The response format may not match what we expect.
error.mcpTokenBadExpiry: Invalid or past expiry. Use a date like 2026-12-31, or leave empty for no expiry
error.mcpTokenInvalid: The MCP token is not valid.
error.mcpTokenNeedsName: Give this integration a name, such as "Claude Code — Ops team". Nobody will dare revoke an unnamed token, because nobody knows who it would cut off.
error.mcpTokenNeedsRole: A role is required. The role decides what this integration can read; leaving it empty bypasses the entire permission model, and does so invisibly — endpoints keep returning data and nobody is alerted.
error.namespaceRequiredForKind: {{kind}} is a namespaced resource, so namespace is required as well.
error.network: Network request failed; the service may be unreachable.
error.noBeforeSnapshot: No before-snapshot was recorded for this change, so it cannot be reverted.
error.noBeforeSnapshotDelete: No before-snapshot was recorded for this deletion, so it cannot be restored.
error.noDomainsParsed: No domains could be parsed from the input. Check its format.
error.noHostMetrics: No host metrics found. Either the host metrics in this data source carry no env/project/team labels, or the filter values are wrong — label values are usually lowercase.
error.noIngressIPsCollected: No ingress IPs were collected (K8s LoadBalancer, cloud LB VIPs, static IPs and host public IPs are all empty), so we can't tell whether the DNS targets still belong to us. Check that the K8s and cloud resource syncs are working first.
error.noPodUsage: No actual pod usage was returned, so waste cannot be computed. Check that this cluster’s Prometheus data source is configured and reachable.
error.noProbeDataSource: No Prometheus / VictoriaMetrics data source is connected, so there is no probe data. Add one under Admin → Observability endpoints.
error.noProjectsForAutoAssign: There are no projects yet, so nothing can be assigned automatically.
error.noRenewableDomains: No domains can be renewed. Per-domain reasons are listed below.
error.noSaKey: This cloud account project has no SA key yet. Add one under Admin → Cloud Accounts.
error.nonJsonResponse: The endpoint returned something other than JSON — most likely blocked by a CDN/WAF, or the response was truncated in transit. See the detail below.
error.notFound: That object does not exist. It may have been deleted.
error.notFoundKind: No such {{kind}}. It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
error.notIngested: This data has not been ingested yet — that is not the same as having no data.
error.nothingToRetry: This record has no failed items to retry.
error.nothingToRollback: This operation made no local changes that can be rolled back.
error.nothingToSet: Select at least one field to set.
error.obsQueryMissingTarget: Provide either a query, or all three of target, name and metric.
error.parsePipelineRunsFailed: Could not parse the pipeline run records.
error.passwordHashFailed: Failed to hash the password. Retry, or contact an administrator.
error.passwordManagedByPortal: This account comes from SSO; its password is managed by the identity provider and cannot be reset here.
error.passwordManagedByPortalSelf: Your account comes from SSO and its password is managed by the identity provider - changing it here would be overwritten at the next login. Change it there instead.
error.passwordSameAsOld: The new password must differ from the old one.
error.passwordTooCommon: That is a widely known default password and cannot be used. Choose one only you know.
error.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
error.permServiceUnavailable: The permission service is temporarily unavailable. This is not a problem with your account — try again shortly.
error.permissionDenied: Your role does not allow this action. This is unrelated to your license tier — ask an administrator to grant it.
error.pipelineLogFetchFailed: Couldn't fetch the build log. Check the pipeline name and build number, and that the log hasn't been cleared by the retention policy.
error.pipelineLogRequired: To read a build log, cluster, namespace, pipeline and build number are all required.
error.pipelineRunsParseHint: If “got” looks like truncated JSON, the response was probably too large and got cut off. If it's HTML, it was probably an auth redirect.
error.pipelineRunsRequired: To list builds, pick a cluster and the namespace the DevOps project lives in.
error.privateKeyDecryptFailed: Could not decrypt the private key; the master key may have changed. Contact an administrator — an empty key must not be issued in this case.
error.probeNotConfigured: No probe bandwidth limit configured (PROBE_BANDWIDTH_KBPS); the probe was refused. ⚠️ This is not a failure — probing consumes uplink bandwidth and must be given an explicit ceiling first, or a full sweep can saturate the uplink and disrupt production traffic.
error.projectInUse: {{count}} namespaces are still assigned to project "{{name}}" ({{where}}). Deleting it pushes their cost into "unassigned" and they can no longer be filtered by project. Reassign them first.
error.promListLabelValuesFailed: Could not fetch the label values (HTTP {{status}}).
error.promListMetricsFailed: Could not fetch the metric list (HTTP {{status}}).
error.promParseLabelValuesFailed: Could not parse the label values.
error.promParseMetricsFailed: Could not parse the metric list.
error.rateAlreadyExists: A rate for this combination already exists. Edit the existing entry instead of adding a duplicate.
error.rateRegionDiskRequired: Both region and disk type are required.
error.rateRegionFamilyRequired: Both region and machine family are required.
error.readOnly: Your license has expired. The system is read-only and write operations are disabled.
error.readSyncProgressFailed: Could not read the sync progress.
error.readonlyMode: The system is read-only; configuration cannot be changed.
error.renewBatchLimit: At most {{max}} domains can be renewed at once; you selected {{got}}. Split it into batches.
error.renewCountChanged: The number of renewable domains changed ({{confirmed}} when you confirmed, {{now}} now). Preview again before running this.
error.renewTaskGone: This renewal task does not exist or has expired (older than 2 hours). Expiry does not mean it did not run — check the renewal history for the actual outcome.
error.revertConflict: This record was modified again after the change you're rolling back, so the rollback would overwrite those later edits.
error.revertConflictHint: If that's acceptable, force the rollback — a forced rollback still records an audit entry.
error.revertExternalHint: Go to the DNS records page and restore the original values shown in the change detail. Doing so records a new audit entry of its own.
error.revertExternalUnsupported: This change also modified an external system (DNS records), so it can't be rolled back in one click.
error.revertOneByOne: Roll these back one at a time after reviewing each. Bulk rollback skips conflict detection, which is too risky.
error.roleManagedByPortal: This account’s permissions are assigned in the Ops Portal. Change them under Role Management there; changes made here have no effect.
error.secretContentRefusedHint: The configuration compliance page can confirm whether this Secret exists and which keys it has, but never shows the values.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.sourceCredReadFailed: Could not read the data source credentials.
error.sourceMissingOrCredFailed: The data source does not exist, or its credentials could not be read.
error.sourceSyncInProgress: This data source is already syncing. Wait for it to finish and try again.
error.syncInProgress: This project is already syncing. Wait for it to finish and try again.
error.syncRegisterFailed: Could not register the sync state, so the sync did not start.
error.taskNotRetryable: This task does not support retrying.
error.tokenExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.tokenInvalid: Your session credential is invalid. Please sign in again.
error.tokenScopeDenied: This token's project scope does not cover the data you requested.
error.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.unknown: The request failed for an unknown reason.
error.unknownSourceType: Unknown data source type {{type}}. Supported types: {{supported}}.
error.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your network, or whether the service is running.
error.unsupportedKind: Unsupported resource kind {{kind}}. Supported kinds are: {{supported}}.
error.upstreamError: The upstream returned an error. This is usually a problem on their side, not ours.
error.upstreamFailed: An upstream service did not respond properly. This is not a data problem here — retry later or contact your operator.
error.upstreamTimeout: The upstream did not respond in time. It may be unreachable, or the stored credentials may have expired.
error.userCreateConflict: Could not create the user — the name {{name}} may already be taken.
error.userCreateInvalid: Username is required and the password must be at least {{min}} characters.
error.validationFailed: Some fields are invalid — check the ones highlighted.

hint.enableSsoFirst: Single sign-on is not enabled. Sign in as a local administrator, then set the Ops Portal address under Basic Settings → Single Sign-On and enable it.

license.activateHint: Paste the whole activation code from your vendor. It takes effect on this replica immediately; other replicas converge within 20 seconds.
license.capacityHint: Exceeding a limit never blocks an operation. It is only shown here and counted towards your next renewal.
license.expiredBanner: Your license has expired and the system is read-only. No data has been deleted, collection is still running, and writes resume as soon as you renew.
license.featuresMissing: Not included in this tier (available after upgrading):
license.fingerprintBanner: This deployment changed (likely a database restore or migration). The license stops working in {{days}} days.
license.fingerprintHint: Required when requesting or renewing a license. It is derived from this deployment's database, not from the machine it runs on.
license.graceBanner: Your license has expired. You are in a {{days}}-day grace period and nothing is disabled yet. Please renew soon.
license.lapsedBanner: Your license expired more than {{days}} days ago and the system is read-only. Your data is fully retained, but restoring access requires a new purchase.
license.noFeatures: No enterprise features are enabled. A feature turns on only when it is both included in the license and implemented in this build — during the rewrite most capabilities still live in the previous system, so an empty list here is expected.
license.notLicensedBanner: Your license does not cover this product, so the system is read-only. This is not an activation error — check whether your purchase includes this product.
license.notLicensedReason: It is an enterprise feature that your current licence does not include. This is not a failure — retrying will not change it. Contact us to add it.
license.notLicensedTitle: This feature is not in your licence
license.readOnlyTip: The system is read-only right now, so this action is disabled.
license.remindBanner: Your license expires in {{days}} days. Contact your account team to renew; a {{grace}}-day grace period follows the expiry date.
license.retentionUnlimitedHint: Retention set to 0 means never purged — unlimited, which exceeds the licensed cap. Data only grows and will eventually fill the disk. Set a finite number of days under Admin → Basic settings.

statusHint.active: The license is valid. Features and capacity apply as listed below.
statusHint.expired: Past the grace period, the system is read-only. No data has been deleted and collection keeps running; renewing restores writes immediately.
statusHint.finger_mismat: This deployment's install fingerprint differs from the one in the license — typically after a database restore or an environment migration. Send the fingerprint below to your vendor for a replacement; nothing is restricted during the grace period.
statusHint.grace: The license has expired but is still within the grace period. Nothing is restricted yet; renewing restores normal state automatically.
statusHint.lapsed: Expired long ago; renewal is no longer enough and a new purchase is required. All data is still retained.
statusHint.not_activated: You are on the Community edition. Features and capacity follow the community limits; it is fully usable and no activation is required.
statusHint.not_licensed: The license is valid but does not include this product. This is not a wrong activation code — please check what was purchased.

license.title: License
license.unknownStatus: Unrecognised license status ({{status}}). This usually means the server is newer than this UI — please upgrade the frontend.

locale.label: Language
locale.partialHint: The interface is in English, but diagnostic messages produced by the server are still Chinese-only. This is a known limitation, not a missing translation.

notFound.hint: No page matches {{path}}. The link may be outdated or mistyped — this is not a planned feature.
notFound.title: Page not found

perm.reason: Your account is missing the permission below. Send it to an administrator to have it granted on your role.
perm.title: You don't have access to this page

planned.hint: This page is on the roadmap but hasn't been built. It stays in the menu so you can see it's planned, not missing.
planned.title: Not built yet

signIn.networkFailed: Could not reach the server. Check your network or the service status.
signIn.tagline: Turn scattered resources into one ledger you can trust.
signIn.taglineSub: Hosts, Kubernetes, domains, certificates, cost and exposure — collected automatically, readable by people, queryable by AI.
signIn.title: Sign in

state.errorHint: The request did not complete. Details below can help you track it down.

pw.doneBody: Your password has been changed. Please sign in again.
pw.killsSessions: ⚠️ This invalidates all your sessions, including this one — you will need to sign in again. That is intentional: one reason to change a password is suspected compromise, and not ending sessions would defeat it.
pw.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
pw.rule: At least 8 characters, and different from the current one
pw.sameAsOld: New password must differ from the current one
pw.title: Change password
pw.tooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters

user.refreshStale: Could not fetch the latest permissions — still using the old snapshot (portal unreachable or session expired). The menu may still be wrong

write.deleteHint: Collection using it stops immediately. Already collected history is not deleted.
write.noPermission: You do not have permission for this action (requires {{code}}). Send this code to an administrator.
write.readOnly: The license has expired and the system is read-only. Renewing restores writes immediately.
write.secretKeep: Configured — leave blank to keep unchanged
